args.message:
Fix money rounding to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

src/money.py documented ROUND_HALF_EVEN (per FIN-212) and the tests in
tests/test_money.py expect banker's rounding, but the implementation
used ROUND_HALF_UP. Switch the quantize rounding mode to ROUND_HALF_EVEN
so the nightly test suite passes.

args.head: fix/money-bankers-rounding
args.title: Use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in money.py per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was quantizing with ROUND_HALF_UP — despite its docstring already claiming ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

## Changes
- `src/money.py`: import and use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Testing
- CI run on this branch (`08d3cd5986`) passed, including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.

Fixes the nightly test failure related to FIN-212.
